claims.statement: The repetition code f(u) = (u, u) with first-copy decoding has average block error at most 1/20 on BSC(1/10).
For the same code and decoder, implemented as the 33-op straight-line program in proof.md, g executes at most W = 33 <= 2^(101/20) operations of the bsc-ops-v1 model on every received word.

experiments.purpose: Check 9^1000 * 10^46 >= 10^1000 with exact integers, which is equivalent to (9/10)^1000 >= 10^-46.
